faq.q: How long does a website take to build in Dubai?
faq.a: Template builds: 1-2 weeks. Custom-designed sites: 3-6 weeks. Ecommerce and complex builds: 4-10 weeks. Content readiness is the most common cause of delay - having copy and images ready can halve your timeline.

faq.q: Are there ongoing costs after launch?
faq.a: Yes: hosting and domain (modest), platform subscriptions if you use Shopify, Framer, Webflow or Wix, and optional maintenance. A good agency states all of these up front.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to build the website myself?
faq.a: In cash, yes. In outcomes, usually not - DIY sites tend to cost sales through weaker design and conversion. A sensible middle path is a professionally designed site on an easy platform like Wix, Squarespace or Framer that you then run yourself.
